items.question: What is Questivo?
items.answer: A mobile app for scavenger hunts, quiz trails, and real-world missions. Hosts build quests and share a game code. Package: com.zuki.apps.questivo.

items.question: Do players need an account?
items.answer: No account is required to play — join with a nickname and a game code. Hosts can sign in with Google to save and sync quests.

items.question: How do I join a quest?
items.answer: Open Questivo, tap Play, enter the host's game code, or scan the quest QR code. No registration needed.

items.question: What permissions does Questivo use?
items.answer: Camera for photo missions, photos for image selection, and location for GPS checkpoint missions only. Deny permissions and related mission types will not work.

items.question: Is Questivo free?
items.answer: Free to download. Many quests are free to play. Some quests use a one-time unlock. Host Pro is a subscription for larger live rooms — 5 guests free, 50 with Pro. There are no ads.

items.question: Does it track my location?
items.answer: Only when a quest has a GPS checkpoint and you allow location. The phone checks that you arrived. Indoor quests do not use GPS.

items.question: Can I create my own quest?
items.answer: Yes. Use the guided wizard to add riddles, photo missions, GPS checkpoints, QR scans, and a story. Share a code or QR with players.

items.question: Can I delete my host account?
items.answer: Yes. In the app: Settings → Delete account. Or visit https://zukiapps.com/questivo/delete-account.

items.question: When will Questivo be available on the App Store and Google Play?
items.answer: Questivo is currently in development. Store listings are coming soon.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use Questivo and related pages at zukiapps.com/questivo.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the Questivo app and the legal pages we publish for the product.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: Questivo collects limited data to run the app. Quest content you create stays primarily on your device unless you use cloud features.
items: Feedback and support messages you send
Quest titles, clues, and media you add when creating quests (stored on device)
Crash diagnostics (Firebase Crashlytics) in release builds
Purchase records handled by Apple or Google — tokens only, not full card data

section3.title: 3. How we use information
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section4.title: 4. Device permissions
section4.content: Questivo may request camera, photo library, and location permissions for mission types that need them.
section4.content2: You can deny permissions; related mission types will not work. Location is used for GPS checkpoint missions only, not continuous tracking.

section5.title: 5. Storage and retention
section5.content: Quest progress and created quests remain on device until you uninstall.
section5.content2: Crash reports are retained per Firebase and Google policies.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Optional cloud session data may be stored when live hosting or sync is enabled by the host environment.
section6.content2: Firebase, Apple, and Google may process data under their own policies.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or object to certain processing. Contact us to exercise rights.
section7.content2: Questivo is not directed to children under 13 without parental supervision for real-world play.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.

q2.question: Can I run an indoor quest?
q2.answer: Yes. Choose indoor mode — GPS missions are hidden automatically.

q3.question: How do paid quests work?

q4.question: What if a mission needs the camera?

deleteAccount.title: Delete your Questivo account
deleteAccount.metaDescription: How to delete a Questivo host account and associated cloud data. Steps in the app, email request, and what Zuki Apps deletes or keeps.
deleteAccount.intro: Questivo, by Zuki Apps, lets you delete your host account and the cloud data tied to it. Follow the steps below, or email us if you cannot open the app.

warning.title: This cannot be undone
warning.content: Deleting your account removes your host sign-in, published quests, and live rooms. Confirm only if you want that data gone.

steps.title: Delete your account in the app
steps.step2: Sign in with the Google or Apple account you use as a host.
steps.step5: Confirm. Cloud account data is deleted when you confirm.

stepsEmail.title: Request deletion by email
stepsEmail.content: If you cannot open the app, email us with the subject “Delete Questivo account” and the Google or Apple email on the account. We delete the account data within 30 days.

data.title: Data that is deleted
data.item1: Your host sign-in (Google or Apple) and profile
data.item2: Cloud history, sessions, and blocked users
data.item3: Quests you published and live rooms you hosted, including mission photos stored for those quests

kept.title: Data that is kept
kept.intro: The following is not removed by account deletion:
kept.item1: Quests and progress stored only on a device, until that app is uninstalled
kept.item2: Copies other players already saved on their own devices
kept.item3: Crash reports, for up to 90 days
kept.item4: Purchase records, which stay with Google Play or the App Store

retention.title: Retention
retention.content: In the app, cloud account data is deleted when you confirm. Email requests are completed within 30 days. Crash reports may remain for up to 90 days. Players who never signed in have no host account. Uninstalling Questivo removes the data stored on that device.
